message: Antigravity can't reference an environment variable in an MCP config, so @examples/github-mcp's `Authorization` header was left out; add it in Antigravity's MCP settings.

Antigravity can't reference an environment variable in an MCP config, so @examples/github-mcp's `GITHUB_TOKEN` wasn't written; set it in the environment Antigravity starts in, which the server inherits.
